explication: Classic Snapdrop is a browser-based, same-network sharing application. A user selects a discovered peer and sends files or text; the browser negotiates a WebRTC data channel, while the Node server groups peers by IP and relays signaling. The client also presents incoming transfers and supports installable/offline app behavior. The README documents WebSockets, WebRTC, and a progressive web app; detailed UI and service-worker behavior is shown in excerpts, but the HTML and deployment configuration were not sampled.
